issues.t: Piston ring defect can damage the engine (recall)
issues.sym: A knocking or rattling sound from the engine, a check engine light (often code P1327), oil level dropping between changes, rough running, or the engine stalling. In the worst case oil can leak onto hot parts.
issues.why: The oil control rings on the pistons of some 2.0L engines were not heat-treated or made correctly. They wear quickly, let oil burn off, and can lead to serious engine damage. Kia recalled 2021 models first and later added 2021-2023 models.
issues.next: Check your VIN on the NHTSA or Kia recall site. Dealers install free knock-sensing software that warns you early and replace the engine if it is damaged. If you hear knocking or the oil light comes on, stop driving and have it towed to a Kia dealer.

issues.t: IVT transmission slips or hesitates
issues.sym: A delay or lack of pick-up when you press the gas, the engine revving without the car speeding up, rough or jerky shifting, or a check engine light. It is the most-reported problem on the 2021 Seltos, often at low mileage.
issues.why: The continuously variable automatic (Kia calls it IVT) on the 2.0L can slip because of how its control software manages the belt and pulleys. Kia issued a campaign to reprogram the transmission computer and replace the transmission if it has already been damaged.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to check your VIN for campaign SC199. The software update and any needed transmission replacement may be covered. Don't keep driving hard on a slipping transmission.

issues.t: Transmission oil pump controller can overheat and burn (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning at all. You might notice a burning or electrical smell, or smoke from under the car.
issues.why: The electronic controller for the electric transmission oil pump, which keeps the transmission ready when the engine shuts off at stops (Idle Stop & Go), may have damaged parts. It can overheat and start a fire, even when parked.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and leave the hood closed. Call 911 from a safe spot, even if you can't see flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for recall SC275 right away. Until it's fixed, park outside and away from buildings. The dealer replaces the controller for free.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may deploy on their own (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. The side curtain airbags could go off without a crash.
issues.why: A manufacturing error in the side curtain airbag modules can make them deploy unexpectedly, which could injure people inside or cause a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall SC289. The dealer inspects and replaces both side curtain airbag modules for free.

issues.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
issues.sym: The engine cuts out or loses power while driving, sometimes at highway speed, leaving you with warning lights and heavier steering and brakes.
issues.why: Owners of 2024 models have filed about ten NHTSA complaints describing sudden stalls. No single cause has been confirmed and these years are not part of the piston ring recall, so each case needs to be diagnosed.
issues.next: Get safely off the road. Have a Kia dealer read stored codes and check for software updates while the car is under warranty, and file a report at nhtsa.gov if it keeps happening.

issues.t: Engine burning oil between changes
issues.sym: The oil level is low at checks or the low oil light comes on before the next oil change. You may see blue-gray smoke at start-up.
issues.why: Kia has a service bulletin covering excessive oil use on its Nu and Gamma engines, which are used in the Seltos. On the 2.0L, oil burning is also an early sign of the piston ring defect.
issues.next: Check the oil every few fill-ups. If it is using more than about a quart between changes, ask a Kia dealer for an oil consumption test and to check the piston ring recall for your VIN.

issues.t: AWD warning light from a water-damaged AWD computer
issues.sym: The AWD (4WD) warning light comes on and all-wheel drive stops working. The car still drives in front-wheel drive. Often happens in winter.
issues.why: Snow carried in on shoes melts in the driver's footwell and drips onto the AWD control unit under the driver's seat. Over time the water damages its circuit board.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer about campaign SC297. They inspect the unit and wiring, replace them if needed, and add a protective cover. Use rubber floor mats in winter.

issues.t: AWD transfer case leaks oil or smells burnt with the spare tire on
issues.sym: A burning oil smell or even light smoke from the front of the car, especially when driving on the small spare tire, and oil drips near the front axle.
issues.why: The AWD software doesn't always notice the smaller spare tire, so it keeps the AWD engaged. The front transfer case overheats and its oil seal can start to leak.
issues.next: Avoid long trips on the spare. Ask a Kia dealer about campaign SC242, which checks for leaks and updates the AWD software.

issues.t: Instrument cluster stays dark in cold weather
issues.sym: On a cold start the gauge screen stays black, so you can't see your speed or warning lights. Restarting or disconnecting the battery may bring it back temporarily.
issues.why: Several owners of 2024 and 2025 models report the digital cluster failing to power up, mostly in cold weather. Dealers often can't reproduce it, and Kia has not published a fix yet.
issues.next: Note the temperature and time when it happens and take photos. Ask a Kia dealer to check for cluster software updates under warranty, and file a complaint at nhtsa.gov.

issues.t: Horn stops working
issues.sym: Nothing happens when you press the horn pad, sometimes only now and then. Some owners say it came back after a repair and failed again.
issues.why: A failed horn, horn relay, fuse or the steering wheel contact (clock spring) can cause it. It is one of the top complaints on the 2023 Seltos and appears repeatedly in NHTSA complaints for 2024-2025.
issues.next: Check the horn fuse first. If it's fine, have the horn and its wiring tested. A working horn is a safety item, so get it fixed under warranty if you can.

issues.t: Creaking or clunking when turning the steering wheel
issues.sym: A creak, groan or clunk from the front when you turn the wheel, both while moving and when parked.
issues.why: The bearings and rubber spring pads at the top of the front struts wear or bind. Kia has a bulletin to replace them on both sides.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer check it under bulletin CHA121 while the car is under warranty. It isn't urgent, but worn strut bearings can affect alignment over time.

issues.t: Easy theft on key-start models without an immobilizer
issues.sym: Damage to the steering column or ignition, a broken window, or the car missing. Thieves target key-start Kias that lack an engine immobilizer.
issues.why: Some 2021 and 2022 Seltos with a regular key were built without an immobilizer, so they can be started without the key. Kia released anti-theft software that stops the engine from starting when the car is locked. It may be covered.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer about anti-theft campaign CS2309. The update may be covered and comes with a window sticker. A steering wheel lock adds more protection.

issues.t: Dual-clutch transmission goes into limp mode
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on and the transmission stays in a limited set of gears, so the car accelerates slowly. Code P060194 is stored.
issues.why: The control software in the 7-speed dual-clutch transmission can wrongly decide there is a fault and limit shifting. Kia released a software fix.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer apply service action SA454. It is a software update.

issues.t: Check engine light with codes P0605 or P2181
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on but the car seems to run normally.
issues.why: The engine computer's logic can falsely flag an internal fault or a thermostat problem. Kia released a software update.
issues.next: Have the codes read. If they match, a Kia dealer can apply service action SA463, a software update.

issues.t: Front camera warning and driver-assist faults
issues.sym: A warning light for the forward collision or lane keeping system, and those features stop working.
issues.why: The windshield-mounted front camera on some early cars needed new software or replacement. Some replacement cameras also shipped without the latest software.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer check for bulletins ELE223, ELE224 and ELE246. Don't rely on automatic braking or lane assist until it's fixed.

issues.t: Power steering warning light at start-up
issues.sym: A warning light with code C160404 comes on just after you start the car.
issues.why: The electric power steering system's start-up self-check can set a false fault. Kia released new software.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. If steering feels normal, it is not an emergency. Have a Kia dealer apply service action SA466.

issues.t: Several warning lights at once from stability control code C1626
issues.sym: Multiple dash lights such as ABS and stability control come on together.
issues.why: The stability control computer can miscalculate how the car is turning when the wheel alignment is slightly off or the tires are different sizes. Kia updated the software to be less sensitive.
issues.next: Make sure all four tires match in size and wear. A Kia dealer can apply the software update in bulletin CHA117.

issues.t: Instrument cluster restarts during navigation
issues.sym: The digital gauge screen blinks off and reboots while navigation directions are running, then stops when you cancel the route.
issues.why: A software bug in the cluster on cars with the 7-inch digital display. Kia released an update.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer for the cluster software update in bulletin ELE325.

issues.t: Radio won't respond on the touchscreen
issues.sym: Tapping the radio icon or pressing the radio button does nothing, so you can't get AM, FM or satellite radio. The screen may also freeze with wired CarPlay.
issues.why: Software problems in the 10.25-inch navigation head unit. Kia released updates.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer for the head unit update in bulletins ELE303 or ELE317. Updates may be covered under warranty.

issues.t: Power side mirrors won't adjust
issues.sym: One or both outside mirrors won't move when you use the mirror switch.
issues.why: A faulty mirror switch on some 2024 Seltos built between late May and mid-July 2023.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to inspect the switch under bulletin ELE307.

issues.t: Windshield cracks easily
issues.sym: A chip or crack in the windshield that spreads, sometimes without an obvious impact.
issues.why: Several owners have reported windshield chips and cracks to NHTSA. Thin modern glass and heat stress can let small chips spread.
issues.next: Get small chips repaired quickly before they spread. If the crack is in the camera area, the front camera must be recalibrated after a new windshield.

issues.t: Low-beam headlights look dim or aimed too low
issues.sym: The low beams look weak or yellow, light up only a short distance ahead, and make road signs hard to read at night.
issues.why: Owners have filed several NHTSA complaints about poor low-beam reach. The cause can be headlight aim or the design of the lamp.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check and adjust the headlight aim. If it's still poor, file a complaint at nhtsa.gov.

issues.t: Rattle or clunk from the rear seat
issues.sym: A rattle or clunk from the back seat area over bumps.
issues.why: Kia's technical team noted the rear seat latches or backrest can rattle on some early cars.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to inspect and adjust the rear seat under Kia's PS695 guidance.
